method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Integer generator: count, min, max
features.detail: 1 to 10,000 integers between -1e9 and 1e9
features.verse_evidence: random/index.html From / To / How many (up to 10,000)

features.name: Columns
features.detail: arrange the integers in N columns
features.verse_evidence: random/index.html "Columns in a line 1..10"

features.name: Base 2 / 8 / 10 / 16
features.detail: write the numbers in binary, octal, decimal or hex
features.verse_evidence: random/index.html "Base decimal binary octal hex"

features.name: Plain-text or HTML output
features.detail: format=plain for scripts
features.verse_evidence: Copy and Copy link; no plain-text endpoint for scripts

features.name: Repeatable randomisation (persistent identifier / date)
features.detail: rnd=id.<x> or date.<iso> gives the same draw again
features.verse_evidence: random/index.html "public, checkable draw": the drand round is in the link and re-derives the numbers

features.name: True randomness from atmospheric noise
features.detail: numbers from radio noise, not a PRNG
features.verse_evidence: device crypto.getRandomValues, or the public drand beacon (true randomness from a distributed beacon, not atmospheric noise)

features.name: Sequence generator / randomizer
features.detail: shuffle every integer in a range into a random order
features.verse_evidence: "no repeats" with How many = the whole range gives a shuffled sequence; no dedicated sequence control

features.name: Integer sets
features.detail: several sets of non-repeating integers, optionally sorted
features.verse_evidence: "no repeats" and "sorted" for one set; no multiple sets at once

features.name: List randomizer
features.detail: shuffle a pasted list
features.verse_evidence: random/index.html "Pick from a list or shuffle it": Pick one / Shuffle all

features.name: Gaussian generator
features.detail: numbers from a normal distribution with mean and deviation
features.verse_evidence: no distribution choice on /random/

features.name: Decimal fractions
features.detail: random decimals with chosen decimal places
features.verse_evidence: Decimals: 1 to 10 places, each step of the range equally likely, written exactly (?dec=4)

features.name: Raw bytes download
features.detail: random bytes as a file
features.verse_evidence: none

features.name: String generator
features.detail: random strings from chosen character sets
features.verse_evidence: random strings live on /password/, not on /random/

features.name: Password generator
features.detail: random passwords
features.verse_evidence: /password/ (Verse page)

features.name: Dice roller
features.detail: roll up to six dice with dice faces
features.verse_evidence: dice are answered on the stage (chance skill, skills/calc-more.js note); /random/ has no dice view

features.name: Coin flipper with 100 world coins
features.detail: flip a coin chosen from 100 real coins
features.verse_evidence: /flip/ coin picker of real coins (skills/coin.js)

features.name: Playing card shuffler
features.detail: shuffle decks and turn cards over one at a time
features.verse_evidence: Shuffle and deal playing cards: 1 to 8 decks, jokers, dealt round 1 to 8 hands or turned over one at a time, with the cards left

features.name: Lotto quick pick
features.detail: quick picks for 150+ named lotteries
features.verse_evidence: a link like ?n=6&unique=1&min=1&max=49 makes a lottery line; no named lottery list

features.name: Keno / bingo cards
features.detail: quick picks for keno and printable bingo cards
features.verse_evidence: none

features.name: Calendar dates and clock times
features.detail: random dates in a range, random times of day
features.verse_evidence: Random dates and times: a date range, dates, dates and times or times of day, weekdays only, sorted, copy

features.name: Geographic coordinates
features.detail: random points on Earth
features.verse_evidence: none

features.name: Bitmaps and audio noise
features.detail: random bitmap images and audio noise files
features.verse_evidence: none

features.name: Third-Party Draw Service
features.detail: certified prize draws with a public record of the result
features.verse_evidence: public, checkable drand draw anyone can re-derive; no organiser account or certificate

features.name: Multi-round giveaways
features.detail: paid giveaway service with several rounds and public records
features.verse_evidence: none

features.name: JSON-RPC / HTTP API with quota
features.detail: free quota and paid API plans, signed results
features.verse_evidence: no public random-number API endpoint

features.name: Web widgets
features.detail: embed a generator on your own site
features.verse_evidence: no embed snippet

features.name: Mobile app with unlockable randomizers
features.detail: official app; some randomizers unlocked for a fee
features.verse_evidence: no native app; page works offline

features.name: Statistics on the generator
features.detail: real-time statistics on the bits served
features.verse_evidence: none
